needs_improvement.label: Needs Improvement

developing.label: Developing
developing.description: You are making progress but have room to grow.

proficient.label: Proficient
proficient.description: You have a solid understanding of the material.

mastered.label: Mastered
mastered.description: You have a strong command of this topic.

medium_score.title: Good Progress — Strengthen Weak Areas

high_score.title: Ready for the Next Lesson
high_score.message: Great performance! You are ready to move on to the next lesson.

mastery.title: Topic Mastered

retry_quiz.title: Retake the Quiz

take_quiz.title: Take the Quiz

start_learning.title: Start Your Learning Journey

standard.description: Continue at the current pace with occasional review.

advanced.label: Advanced Challenge
advanced.description: You are ready for more challenging material.
advanced.message: Your strong performance shows you are ready to take on more advanced concepts.
